newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco O'Higgins started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco O'Higgins started.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Catherine Gex said she initiated coverage of Chile's Banco O'Higgins and Banco Santander-Chile with a hold rating.

-- "Chile offers one of the safest banking environments in Latin America: economic growth is among the fastest in the region with well balanced fundamentals and the banking sector is tightly regulated and dominated by privately owned banks," Gex said.
-- But she added that the sector's growth potential was limited currently as a result of of restrictive monetary policies and strong competition between banks.
-- Banco Santander was unchanged at 13-3/8 on the NYSE while Banco O'Higgins was not yet trading on Thursday morning.
